title: Error envelope shape on all non-2xx responses
objective: Verify every error response (400/401/403/404/409/500) uses the documented envelope: error{code,message,field_errors,correlation_id,retryable}.
test_data: trigger each status: 400 (bad payload), 401 (no auth), 403 (employee create), 404 (random uuid), 409 (stale version), and a forced 500 if safely triggerable
steps: Parse and validate JSON structure of each response: keys, types, non-empty code/message, UUID correlation_id, boolean retryable.
expected_result: All error bodies conform to the envelope; codes come from the documented stable set; messages are user-safe (no stack traces, SQL, or file paths); HTML error pages never returned for API paths.

title: OpenAPI schema available and matches implementation
objective: Verify /api/v1/schema/ serves a valid OpenAPI document; backend/openapi.json export works; delivered endpoints are documented and responses validate against schemas.
test_data: schema fetch; sample responses from assets/auth/dashboard endpoints
steps: GET /api/v1/schema/ — verify 200 and parseable OpenAPI 3.x document.
Run the documented export script/command producing backend/openapi.json.
Validate sample live responses against component schemas (schemathesis or manual key checks).
Confirm all Cycle-1 endpoints from design §11.3 appear in the document.
expected_result: Schema endpoint works unauthenticated-or-as-documented; export artifact generated; all Cycle-1 endpoints documented with request/response schemas; no live response contradicts its schema on field presence/types.

title: Correlation ID echoed on every response
objective: Verify all API responses (success and error) include the correlation ID (header or envelope) and accept client-supplied IDs.
test_data: requests with and without X-Correlation-ID across GET/POST/error paths
steps: Send requests with and without the header across endpoint types.
expected_result: Client-supplied ID echoed verbatim; absent header yields server-generated UUID; error responses carry correlation_id in the envelope.

title: Money and datetime representations conform to contract
objective: Verify money fields serialize as {amount: decimal-string, currency: ISO-4217} and datetimes as ISO 8601 with timezone across all Cycle-1 endpoints.
preconditions: asset with purchase price, warranty dates, created timestamps.
steps: Inspect money fields in asset detail/list responses.
Attempt to PATCH purchase_price with a binary-float precision trap value (0.1+0.2 style '19.99' vs '19.990000000001').
expected_result: Amounts are strings with ≤2 decimal places and a 3-letter currency code; datetimes parse as ISO 8601 with TZ offset; decimal values round-trip exactly (no float artifacts).

title: Health endpoints respond unauthenticated without sensitive data
objective: Verify /api/v1/health/live and /health/ready return 200 without auth and expose only infra status.
steps: Inspect bodies for sensitive content (usernames, counts of business data, internal hostnames beyond necessity).
(If feasible) verify readiness reflects DB connectivity by reviewing implementation or toggling DB in a disposable env.
expected_result: Both return 200 with minimal JSON (status only); no business data or secrets; readiness genuinely checks DB (verified by code review note if runtime toggle not feasible in QA env).

title: Reference data endpoints readable by all roles, writable only by authorized
objective: Verify GET on categories/statuses/conditions/departments/locations/cost-centers/suppliers works for all authenticated roles; POST/PATCH restricted per design.
test_data: all seven reference-data collections; a create payload for a test category
steps: As employee: GET each collection — expect 200 with seeded rows.
As employee: POST/PATCH each collection — expect 403.
As admin: POST a new category; PATCH it; verify changes persisted and audited.
expected_result: Reads succeed for all roles with pagination envelope; writes denied to unauthorized roles with PERMISSION_DENIED; admin writes succeed (201/200) and produce audit events; deactivated/in-use protections per BR-004 noted for Cycle 3 admin UI.
